exposure: lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer identifying
experienced intimate partner or family violence
giving birth during the COVID-19 public health emergency
cohort: 4,458 postpartum individuals who had a live birth in 2020 in 6 states and New York City
finding: Mistreatment during childbirth was common, with more than 1 in 8 individuals reporting experiencing it, and certain factors like sexual orientation, insurance status, pre-pregnancy obesity, unplanned cesarean birth, and history of substance use disorder were associated with a higher likelihood of experiencing mistreatment.
mod_finding: Women who had an unplanned cesarean birth were more likely to report experiencing mistreatment during childbirth (UOR 1.6, 95% CI 1.2-2.2).
